description: Search the slopped.site art collection by words in the title, subtitle or description, optionally within one category. Use to find pieces about a subject or mood. Returns up to `limit` matches with ids, titles, page links and image links; follow up with get_artwork for one piece. With no query, returns the newest pieces.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "moon", "teapot", "fish". Leave out to list the newest.

name: search_artwork
title: Search Fresh slop
